name: SSRF via URL parser differential — needs sandbox reproduction

input.title: URL parser differential may allow internal redirect to metadata service
input.summary: Python urllib follows http://attacker.com#@169.254.169.254/ differently from requests. Without running a real DNS+HTTP reproduction, we cannot tell whether the differential is exploitable. Deployment uses EKS.

rationale: Requires sandbox + DNS rebinding reproduction. Per Spec §25, missing sandbox capability ⇒ verdict=needs_validation. Spec §19: needs_validation must not assign a formal severity.
